name: flow-steward-operator
description: Build, run and manage Flow Steward automations through your Flow Steward MCP connection: workflows, agents and skills, runs, approvals and operational reports. Also reports issues and shares workflow templates.

mcp_url.title: Flow Steward MCP address
mcp_url.description: The MCP address of your own Flow Steward installation, ending in /mcp, as its AI-agent setup page shows it.

mcp_token.title: Flow Steward personal access token
mcp_token.description: A personal access token from your Flow Steward user settings. It is kept in your system credential store, never in the plugin.
